admin.auth.anonymous: Visitors who are not signed in may read what %s reads
admin.auth.anonymous-refresh: and may have the feeds refreshed
admin.auth.auto-register: Create a user for a name the reverse proxy or the provider vouches for and nobody has
admin.auth.force-email: A user has to confirm their e-mail address before using the account
admin.auth.form: a login with name and password
admin.auth.hint: Without a login everybody who reaches the server is let in: leave that to a server only you can reach.
admin.auth.http_auth: the reverse proxy in front of the server (Remote-User)
admin.auth.no-mail: The server was started without an SMTP server (-smtp-url): it cannot send the letters that confirm addresses.
admin.auth.none: nothing: everybody is the default user
admin.auth.oidc: Signing in through a provider (OpenID Connect)
admin.auth.oidc.hint: Next to the login by password. Register a client at the provider with the callback address %s; the user is the one the provider names in preferred_username. Leave both fields empty for no provider.
admin.auth.oidc.no-secret: The server was started without the secret of the client (-oidc-client-secret): nobody can sign in through a provider until it is.
admin.authentication.heading: Signing in
admin.log.heading: Journal of everybody
admin.problem.lockout: This way of telling users apart would not know you: the reverse proxy has to name you on this very request, and the default user has to exist.
admin.problem.name: This cannot be a user name.
admin.problem.name-taken: A user has this name already.
admin.problem.no-mail: Addresses cannot be confirmed without an SMTP server: start the server with -smtp-url first.
admin.problem.no-password: You have no password for the web interface: with signing in by password you would be locked out. Set one in your profile first.
admin.problem.number: The numbers have to be zero or more.
admin.problem.oidc: The provider takes both an address starting with https:// and a client ID, or neither.
admin.problem.protected: This cannot be done to your own account or to that of the default user.
admin.problem.proxy: The proxy has to be an address such as socks5://127.0.0.1:1080, with the scheme http, https, socks5 or socks5h.
admin.system.allowlist: Internal addresses feeds may be fetched from

admin.system.closed-message: What visitors read when registration is closed
admin.system.cookie-days: Days a remembered login lasts without being used
admin.system.heading: System
admin.system.language: Language for visitors whose browser asks for none of ours
admin.system.max-registrations: Users from which on nobody can register
admin.system.max-registrations.hint: 1 closes registration, 0 leaves it open for good.
admin.system.media: Images of entries the server hands out from its own address
admin.system.media.hint: The sites then see the server and not the reader. Images served over http are not shown on a page served over https unless the server hands them out.
admin.system.proxy.hint: For example http://proxy.example:3128 or socks5h://user:password@127.0.0.1:1080. A feed with a proxy of its own keeps it. Empty for none.
admin.system.reauth-minutes: Minutes after which administration asks for the password again (0 for never)
admin.system.title: Name of the installation
admin.system.tos.hint: With terms, a visitor has to accept them to register. Empty for none.
admin.user.delete.confirm: The user is deleted with every feed, entry and setting. This cannot be undone.
admin.user.name.hint: Up to 39 Latin letters, digits and _ . @ -, starting with a letter, a digit or _.
admin.user.password.hint: For the web interface and for apps alike. Whoever is signed in with the old one is signed out.
admin.user.protected: Your own account and that of the default user cannot be kept out, demoted or deleted here.
admin.users.heading: Users

category.among: Among how many of the newest entries

category.default: The category of feeds without one cannot be renamed.

category.empty.confirm.one: %d feed of the category is deleted with its entries.
category.empty.confirm.other: %d feeds of the category are deleted with their entries.

category.heading: Settings of a category
category.opml.failed: The last attempt to read the document failed.
category.opml.hint: With an address, the feeds of the category are those the document lists: feeds are added and muted as the document changes.
category.position.hint: Categories with a place come first, lowest number first. Leave it empty for no place.
category.same-guid: Mark an entry as read when another one of the category has its identifier
category.same-title: Mark an entry as read when another one of the category has its title
error.400.heading: Request not understood
error.400.text: The server could not read this request.
error.403.heading: Not allowed
error.403.text: You do not have access to this page.
error.404.heading: Page not found
error.404.text: There is nothing at this address.
error.405.heading: Not possible here
error.405.text: This address does not take this kind of request.
error.500.heading: Something went wrong
error.500.text: The server could not finish the request. The details are in its log.
feed.content-action: What the text of the page does to the text of the feed
feed.cookie-file: Keep the cookies a redirect sets
feed.delete.confirm: The feed and every entry of it are deleted.
feed.failing: The last refresh failed, at %s. The log of the server says why.
feed.fulltext.auto: Find the article on its page without a selector
feed.fulltext.auto.hint: The text of every new entry is taken from the page it links to, the way the reader view of a browser finds it. The selector of the article is then not used.
feed.fulltext.browser: Read the pages with a browser
feed.fulltext.browser.hint: For a site that lets only a browser through to its pages, as behind a check of Cloudflare. It does nothing by itself: pages are read when the article is looked for without a selector, or a selector is given. The browser of the server opens every page, which takes seconds; the proxy, the cookies and the user agent set for the feed do not apply to it.
feed.heading: Settings of a feed
feed.http-password.hint: Leave it empty to keep the password there is.
feed.icon.file: A picture of your own, up to 1 MB
feed.icon.reset: Go back to the icon of the site
feed.kind.rss-forced: RSS or Atom, whatever the document looks like
feed.max-unread: Unread entries the feed may hold; older ones become read
feed.mute: Muted: the feed is not refreshed
feed.preview: Try it on the newest entry
feed.preview.browser-alone: The pages are to be read by a browser, but nothing says how the article is found on them: check "Find the article on its page without a selector" or give a selector.
feed.preview.empty: Nothing is taken from the page.
feed.preview.failed: The page could not be read, no article was found on it, or the selector is not valid CSS.
feed.preview.heading: What is taken from the newest entry
feed.preview.no-entries: The feed has no entry with a link to try it on.
feed.preview.no-selector: There is no selector to try, and the article is not looked for without one.
feed.priority.feed: On the page of the feed only
feed.priority.hidden: Hidden: on the page of the feed only
feed.priority.important: In the main stream, as important
feed.proxy.none: That of the installation, if it has one
feed.read-upon-gone: Mark entries as read when the feed no longer lists them
feed.read-upon-reception: Mark entries as read when they arrive
feed.redirects: Redirects to follow at most (empty for the usual number, 0 for none, -1 for any)
feed.same-title: Mark an entry as read when one of the newest entries has its title: among how many (0 turns it off)
feed.selector: CSS selector of the article on its page
feed.selector-conditions: Take the page only for entries that match
feed.selector-filter: CSS selector of what to leave out
feed.selector.hint: With a selector, the text of every new entry is taken from the page it links to.
feed.truncate.confirm: Every entry of the feed is deleted, starred ones too. The feed stays.
feed.ttl: Do not refresh more often than every
feed.unicity.forced: Keep to this even when it does not tell the entries apart
feed.unicity.id: the identifier the feed gives them
feed.unicity.sha1:title: title
feed.updated-unread: Mark an entry as unread when the feed changes it
feed.xpath: XPath expressions, for a web page or an XML document
feed.xpath-to-json: XPath of the JSON inside the page

keys.failed: The keys were not saved: some of them cannot be used as they are.
keys.heading: Keys
keys.intro: Every action of the reading screen has a key. Leave a field empty to take the key away; the action stays in the command palette.
keys.notation: A key is a character (j, J, ?), a named key (Space, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Backspace, Delete, Insert, F1 to F12), either one with Ctrl+, Alt+ or Meta+ before it, or two keys pressed one after the other, written with a space between them (g u). Enter, Escape and Ctrl+K always do the same.
keys.single: Keys pressed alone, without Ctrl, Alt or Meta, are on
label.delete.confirm: The label is taken off every entry and deleted. The entries stay.
label.filters: Give the label to new entries that match

log.clear.confirm: Every record about you is deleted.
log.clear.confirm.all: Every record about every user is deleted.
log.intro: Warnings and errors of the server about your feeds, kept for 30 days.
log.intro.all: Warnings and errors of the server about the feeds of every user, kept for 30 days.
